section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a validation study of the BAS-2 translated into Polish. A bilingual sample of 70 English Studies Master's degree students (53 women, 17 men) completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires. The study involved two subsamples: the first completed only the BAS-2, while the second completed all measures; data were collected in January-February 2017through personal contacts and direct solicitation.
